deskyard account create: create an account

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] account create USER [OPTIONS]

Creates an account. With --password-stdin it signs in with that password;
without one it is a token account, which signs in with a login link: the link
is printed, and works once.

Arguments:
  USER       string      required  username

Options:
  --password-stdin     read the password from stdin (without the final line
                       break)
  --admin              make it an administrator (full access to everything, and
                       these commands)
  --description TEXT   who it is for (at most 200 characters)
  --grant ENV[=observe] give full access to an environment, or observe-only with
                       =observe (repeatable)
  --expires WHEN       when the account ends: a time from now (90m, 2h, 7d, 2w)
                       or an RFC 3339 time (2026-12-01T18:00:00Z)

Prints: for a token account its login link alone on stdout (what it gives on
  stderr); for a password account a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard account create anna --grant alice
  printf '%s' "$PW" | deskyard account create carl --password-stdin --admin
  deskyard account create guest --grant demo=observe --expires 7d

Where: on this machine, talking to the chosen server: the one -e SERVER/ (or -e SERVER/ENV) names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
